select count(*) from Market_Investment_Payment mn
left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join SYS_User u on mn.Create_Uid=u.U_ID
and mn.P_Id = #{params.pId}
and mn.Con_Id = #{params.conId}
and con.Con_Name like concat('%',#{params.conName},'%')
and likePname(#{params.pName},pro.P_Id)=true
and INSTR(pro.P_Name,#{params.pName})
